text: The paper reports on Common MT that MAPS and Self-Reflect improve over the GPT-3.5-Turbo baseline, and that MAD with GPT-3.5-Turbo as backbone shows significant advances over GPT-4 on both automatic (COMET, BLEURT) and human evaluation metrics.
